condemnation.scripture_text: But God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
condemnation.first_person_truth: While I was still a sinner, Christ died for me. The Father's love for me is proven on the Cross.

fear.scripture_text: For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
fear.first_person_truth: The Lord has not given me a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

rejection.scripture_text: Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine.
rejection.first_person_truth: The Lord has redeemed me. He has called me by name. I am His.

shame.scripture_text: There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
shame.first_person_truth: There is no condemnation for me, because I am in Christ Jesus.

anxiety.scripture_text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
anxiety.first_person_truth: The Lord is my peace that surpasses understanding. I bring my anxieties to Him in prayer, and He guards my heart and my mind in Christ Jesus.

anxiety.scripture_text: Cast all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
anxiety.first_person_truth: I cast my anxieties on the Lord, because He cares for me.
